query.name: us.ma.k12.lawrence.classdojo.users
query.sql:
with yearquery as (select id, abbreviation from terms where portion = 1 AND terms.lastday > sysdate AND sysdate > terms.firstday-30 AND schoolid=0 ), TeacherorgSource as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.status = 1 and schoolstaff.staffstatus = 1 and schoolstaff.schoolid != users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceh as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceGroup as (select users.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from users join (select * from TeacherorgSourceh) TeacherorgSourceh on TeacherorgSourceh.dcid = users.dcid left join (select * from TeacherorgSource) TeacherorgSource on TeacherorgSource.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid
group by users.dcid, TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentorgSource as (select distinct students.dcid, cc.schoolid from students join cc on students.id = cc.studentid join yearquery on 1=1 join sections on cc.sectionid = sections.id join teachers t on sections.teacher=t.id and t.ptaccess = 1 and t.status = 1 and t.StaffStatus = 1 where students.enroll_status = 0 and cc.schoolid != students.schoolid and (cc.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99) and cc.dateleft > cc.dateenrolled ), StudentorgSourceh as (select students.dcid, students.schoolid from students ), StudentorgSourceGroup as (select students.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from students join (select * from StudentorgSourceh) StudentorgSourceh on StudentorgSourceh.dcid = students.dcid left join (select * from StudentorgSource) StudentorgSource on StudentorgSource.dcid = students.dcid
group by students.dcid, StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentEmail as (select psc.email as email, stu.dcid as dcid from PSM_STudentcontact psc join psm_studentcontacttype psct on psc.studentcontacttypeid = psct.id and psct.name = 'Self' join sync_studentmap ssm on psc.studentid = ssm.studentid join students stu on ssm.studentsdcid = stu.dcid ), studenttocontact as (select students.dcid, person.id from students join studentcontactassoc on students.dcid = studentcontactassoc.studentdcid join person on studentcontactassoc.personID = person.id join PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT on person.id = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.CONTACTPERSONID and studentcontactassoc.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID and students.dcid = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTDCID left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and Guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where (PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.ISCUSTODIAL = 1 or PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.LIVESWITHFLG = 1 OR GuardianStudent.GuardianID is not null) and students.enroll_status in (0,-1) ), studenttocontactGroup as (select students.dcid, -- listagg() creates comma-separated aggregate list for all linked contacts, then replace() removes those that don't have an account case when (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) = 'C' then null else (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from students left join (select * from studenttocontact ) studenttocontact on studenttocontact.dcid = students.dcid Group by students.dcid ), contacttostudents as (select person.id as CTSPersonID, studentcontactassoc.studentdcid from person join studentcontactassoc on person.id = studentcontactassoc.personID join StudentContactDetail on studentcontactassoc.StudentContactAssocID = StudentContactDetail.StudentContactAssocID join students on studentcontactassoc.studentdcid = students.dcid join PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT on person.id = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.CONTACTPERSONID and studentcontactassoc.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID and students.dcid = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTDCID left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and Guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where (PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.ISCUSTODIAL = 1 or PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.LIVESWITHFLG = 1 OR GuardianStudent.GuardianID is not null) and students.enroll_status in (0,-1) ), contacttostudentGroup as (select person.id as CTSGPersonID, case when (replace(listagg('S'||CTS.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id),'S,','')) = 'S' then null else (replace(listagg('S'||CTS.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id),'S,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from person left join (SELECT * FROM contacttostudents) CTS on CTS.CTSPersonID = person.id group by person.id ), contacttostudentSchool as (select person.id as CTSSPersonID, case when (listagg(DISTINCT students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id)) is null then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else (listagg( DISTINCT students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id)) end as orgSourcedIds from person join (SELECT * FROM contacttostudents) CTS on CTS.CTSPersonID = person.id join students on students.dcid = CTS.studentdcid group by person.id ), contactPhoneLand_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by PSSIS_Person_Phone.IsPreferred DESC, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 0 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL ), contactPhoneLand as (select contactPhoneLand_Group.PersonID, contactPhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumber, contactPhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumberExt, contactPhoneLand_Group.PhoneType from contactPhoneLand_Group where contactPhoneLand_Group.rn = 1 ), contactPhoneSMS_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by PSSIS_Person_Phone.IsPreferred DESC, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 1 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL ), contactPhoneSMS as (select contactPhoneSMS_Group.PersonID, contactPhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumber, contactPhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumberExt, contactPhoneSMS_Group.PhoneType from contactPhoneSMS_Group where contactPhoneSMS_Group.rn = 1 ), contactEmail_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Email.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Email.EmailAddress, row_number () over ( partition by PSSIS_Person_Email.PersonID order by PSSIS_Person_Email.IsPrimaryEmailAddress DESC, PSSIS_Person_Email.EmailAddressPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Email ), contactEmail1 as (select contactEmail_Group.PersonID as CE1PersonID, contactEmail_Group.EmailAddress from contactEmail_Group where contactEmail_Group.rn = 1 ), contactEmaillogin as (select person.ID, pcas_emailcontact.emailaddress from person join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join pcas_account on GUARDIAN.accountidentifier = pcas_account.pcas_accounttoken left join pcas_emailcontact on pcas_account.pcas_accountID = pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountid ), contactEmailmix as (select person.id, case when contactEmaillogin.id Is Not Null then contactEmaillogin.emailaddress else contactEmail1.EmailAddress end as EmailAddress from person left join (select * from contactEmail1) contactEmail1 on person.id = contactEmail1.CE1PersonID left join (select * from contactEmaillogin) contactEmaillogin on person.id = contactEmaillogin.ID ) -- contactLanguage_Group as (select -- person.id as contactLanguagePersonID, -- Codeset.Code, -- row_number () over ( -- partition by person.id -- order by PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGEPRIORITYORDER ASC -- ) rn -- from person -- join PersonLanguageAssoc on PersonLanguageAssoc.PERSONID = person.id -- join Codeset on Codeset.CODESETID = PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGECODESETID -- ), -- contactLanguage1 as (select -- contactLanguage_Group.contactLanguagePersonID, -- contactLanguage_Group.code -- from contactLanguage_Group -- where contactLanguage_Group.rn = 1 -- ) -- teachers select 'T'||users.dcid as sourcedId, TeacherorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'teacher' as role, users.first_name as givenName, users.last_name as familyName, users.email_addr as email, null as agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, null as primary_language from users left join (select * from TeacherorgSourceGroup) TeacherorgSourceGroup on TeacherorgSourceGroup.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid left join teachers on teachers.users_dcid = users.dcid AND teachers.schoolId = users.homeSchoolId where users.homeschoolid = schoolstaff.schoolid and BITAND(schoolstaff.status, schoolstaff.staffstatus)+0 = 1
union all
-- students select 'S'||students.dcid as sourcedId, StudentorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'student' as role, students.first_name as givenName, students.last_name as familyName, StudentEmail.email as email, studenttocontactGroup.agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, case when students.grade_level <= -3 then 'IT' when students.grade_level between -2 and -1 then 'PK' when students.grade_level = 0 then 'KG' when students.grade_level between 1 and 13 then trim(to_char(students.grade_level,'00')) when students.grade_level > 13 then 'PS' else 'Other' end as grades, null as primary_language from students join schools on students.schoolid = schools.school_number -- School join graph join (select * from StudentorgSourceGroup) StudentorgSourceGroup on StudentorgSourceGroup.dcid = students.dcid -- student email join graph left join (select * from StudentEmail) StudentEmail on StudentEmail.dcid = students.dcid -- multi-guardian join graph join (select * from studenttocontactGroup) studenttocontactGroup on studenttocontactGroup.dcid = students.dcid where students.enroll_status in (0,-1)
union all
-- Contacts select 'C'||person.id as sourcedId, CTSS.orgSourcedIds as orgSourcedIds, 'guardian' as role, person.firstname as givenName, person.lastname as familyName, case when pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountID is null then contactEmail1.EmailAddress else pcas_emailcontact.EmailAddress end as email, contacttostudentGroup.agentSourcedIds as agentSourcedIds, contactPhoneSMS.PhoneNumber as guardian_sms, contactPhoneLand.PhoneNumber as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, CLang1.Code as primary_language from person -- School join graph JOIN (SELECT * FROM contacttostudentSchool) CTSS on CTSS.CTSSPersonID = person.id -- guardian email join graph left join GuardianPersonAssoc on GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID = person.id left join guardian on GuardianPersonAssoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join pcas_account on pcas_account.pcas_accounttoken = guardian.accountidentifier left join pcas_emailcontact on pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountid = pcas_account.pcas_accountID left join (select * from contactEmail1) contactEmail1 on contactEmail1.CE1PersonID = person.id -- multi-student join graph join (select * from contacttostudentGroup) contacttostudentGroup on contacttostudentGroup.CTSGPersonID = person.id -- guardian phone join graph LEFT JOIN (select * from contactPhoneSMS) contactPhoneSMS ON contactPhoneSMS.PersonID = person.id LEFT JOIN (select * from contactPhoneLand) contactPhoneLand ON contactPhoneLand.PersonID = person.id -- guardian language join graph - can not use a CTE with CodeSet Table? -- LEFT JOIN (select * from contactLanguage1) CLang1 ON CLang1.contactLanguagePersonID = person.id left join PersonLanguageAssoc on PersonLanguageAssoc.PERSONID = person.id and PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGEPRIORITYORDER = 1 left join Codeset CLang1 on CLang1.CODESETID = PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGECODESETID where person.IsActive = 1
